title: On characteristic foliations of metric contact-symplectic structures
summary: We study compatible and associated metrics for a contact-symplectic pair $(η, ω)$ on a manifold. We show that the integral curves of the Reeb vector field are geodesics for any compatible metric. We prove that all associated metrics share a common volume element, which we give explicitly. When the characteristic foliations of $η$ and $ω$ are orthogonal with respect to an associated metric, their leaves, as well as those of the characteristic foliation of $dη$, are minimal.
